notes: *so that* is one rendering of the apodosis waw, a conjunction morpheme standing in the clause (rule 55); headed on the coordinator, with the competing head on *that* named in the unit note.
*also* answers to the written גַּם, so rule 51's `added` case does not arise; the לְ of לְיִשְׂרָאֵל is unrepresented because the recasting promotes its object to the English subject (rule 40).
